evals.prompt: Before this assessment goes to the executive team, audit the quality of the sourcing behind its key judgments — I want to know how solid the evidence base is for each conclusion.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Lists the key judgments under audit with their stated confidence; Builds a source inventory with originator, date, access, motive/bias, primary-vs-re-report and an Admiralty grade per source; Builds a source-to-judgment matrix and collapses re-reporting chains before counting independent supports; Assigns a status per judgment (corroborated / thin / single-source / conflicting / unsupported); Writes an ICD 206-style source summary statement and states per judgment whether the stated confidence is warranted or must be lowered.
expectations: Lists the key judgments under audit with their stated confidence
Builds a source inventory with originator, date, access, motive/bias, primary-vs-re-report and an Admiralty grade per source
Builds a source-to-judgment matrix and collapses re-reporting chains before counting independent supports
Assigns a status per judgment (corroborated / thin / single-source / conflicting / unsupported)
Writes an ICD 206-style source summary statement and states per judgment whether the stated confidence is warranted or must be lowered

evals.prompt: Run a quality-of-information check on this report's evidence base.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Runs the six-step procedure: judgments, source inventory, matrix, status flags, gaps and deception flags, source summary statement; States gaps per judgment as missing expected reporting rather than 'none identified'; Uses the output template with inventory, matrix, source summary statement and confidence per judgment.
expectations: Runs the six-step procedure: judgments, source inventory, matrix, status flags, gaps and deception flags, source summary statement
States gaps per judgment as missing expected reporting rather than 'none identified'
Uses the output template with inventory, matrix, source summary statement and confidence per judgment

evals.prompt: Which of our conclusions rest on a single source or on re-reported information? Several of the citations look like they trace back to the same press release.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Traces 'according to' chains to their origin and collapses items that share an origin into one source; Flags single-source and thin judgments explicitly and names the most compelling source for each; Recommends lowering confidence on judgments that rest on one origin.
expectations: Traces 'according to' chains to their origin and collapses items that share an origin into one source
Flags single-source and thin judgments explicitly and names the most compelling source for each
Recommends lowering confidence on judgments that rest on one origin

evals.prompt: Write an ICD 206 style source summary statement for this intelligence assessment: how good is our source base overall, which sources carry the key judgments, where is it corroborated or conflicting, and what are the gaps?
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Produces a source summary statement covering strengths and weaknesses, most important sources, corroborative vs conflicting reporting, and expertise used; Grounds the statement in a source inventory and a source-to-judgment matrix rather than writing it from impression; States gaps and any deception or denial flags.
expectations: Produces a source summary statement covering strengths and weaknesses, most important sources, corroborative vs conflicting reporting, and expertise used
Grounds the statement in a source inventory and a source-to-judgment matrix rather than writing it from impression
States gaps and any deception or denial flags

evals.prompt: How reliable is this one outlet as a source for the claim? Give me an Admiralty grade with a rationale.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Grades the single source on the A–F / 1–6 Admiralty axes (rate-source-admiralty behaviour); Does not build a whole-evidence-base inventory or a source summary statement.
expectations: Grades the single source on the A–F / 1–6 Admiralty axes (rate-source-admiralty behaviour)
Does not build a whole-evidence-base inventory or a source summary statement

evals.prompt: Is this website legit? I have never heard of it — can I trust this article before I cite it?
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Runs the SIFT lateral-reading moves on the one unfamiliar source (sift-source-check behaviour); Does not audit an assessment's whole evidence base.
expectations: Runs the SIFT lateral-reading moves on the one unfamiliar source (sift-source-check behaviour)
Does not audit an assessment's whole evidence base

evals.prompt: Find me two independent sources that corroborate this funding-round figure before it goes in the executive summary.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Corroborates the single claim across independent sources (triangulate-sources behaviour); Does not inventory every source behind a set of judgments.
expectations: Corroborates the single claim across independent sources (triangulate-sources behaviour)
Does not inventory every source behind a set of judgments
